reviewCharts.warning: Alaska review coverage uses official ENR precinct/reporting-unit President and U.S. Representative named-candidate first-choice rows. Alaska used ranked-choice voting for U.S. House; the ENR precinct CSV does not itemize U.S. House write-in rows, leaving a 750-vote statewide write-in gap versus the summary PDF. Rows include Election Day precincts plus absentee, early, question, and remote reporting units and are not geometry-ready precinct polygons.

turnout.notes: Alaska turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 jurisdiction fallback rows. The statewide EAC ballots-cast and registered-voter totals match the official Alaska summary report Times Cast row and the de-duplicated ENRbyPrecinct.csv Reg_voters/total_ballots fields. Wave 2 verification keeps ENR turnout as a documented lead, not an active replacement, because 120 district absentee/early/question reporting units carry 165,047 ballots with zero registered voters and would produce misleading lower-grain turnout percentages without source-side denominator semantics.
